combo_box.name: audio_output_device
combo_box.tool_tip: Where all of the viewer's sound plays: world sounds and voice. System default follows your system's sound settings. A device picked under Voice Input/Output devices still wins for voice. Media (web pages, video, music played through the media plugins) stays on the system default.

combo_box.name: audio_input_device
combo_box.tool_tip: The microphone the viewer uses (voice). System default follows your system's sound settings. A device picked under Voice Input/Output devices still wins for voice.
